name: Meow Bazar — Online Shop System
tagline: A complete cash-on-delivery online shop for Bangladesh: storefront, customer accounts, offers, vouchers, profit tracking and sales reports — in one system you can run from your phone.
description: Meow Bazar is my own live cat-supply shop, and the same system can be set up for your business under your name, logo and colours. Customers browse by category, pick sizes, apply a voucher and order with cash on delivery — no account needed, or sign in to save their address and track orders. You manage everything from a private admin panel: orders, products and stock, timed sales with a countdown, voucher codes, customers, expenses, purchase prices and profit reports.
priceNote: Price depends on your products, branding and extra features — ask for a quote.
highlights: Cash on delivery checkout with inside / outside Dhaka delivery charges and free delivery over a set amount
Customer accounts with saved address and order history (email sign-in; Google and phone OTP ready to switch on)
Timed sales with a live countdown banner, plus voucher codes with usage rules
Admin panel for orders, products, sizes, stock and photos
Profit and loss, best sellers, daily sales chart and where orders came from
Facebook Pixel and Google Analytics ready, CSV export of customers
shopFeatures: Home page with categories, shop-by-age and best sellers
Search, filters (category, age, on offer) and sorting
Product pages with sizes, stock left and sale price
Cart with voucher box and free-delivery progress bar
Checkout in under a minute: name, phone, area, address
Order confirmation and optional WhatsApp message
Customer account: saved details and order status
Policy pages: delivery, returns, privacy, terms
Phone-first design with a bottom navigation bar
adminFeatures: Orders: status flow, private notes, call / WhatsApp the customer
Products: sizes, prices, old price, stock, photos, show / hide
Sales: % off everything, a category or chosen products, with start and end time
Vouchers: % or taka off, free delivery, minimum order, limits per customer
Customers: repeat, one-time and sleeping customers, CSV download
Money: expenses by type and purchase price of every size
Reports: sales, profit, best sellers, sources, low stock
Settings: shop details, delivery charges, marketing IDs, link maker for ads
included: Your own copy of the shop with your name, logo and colours
Set up on your own hosting and database accounts (free plans to start)
Your domain connected, if you have one
Admin login for you and a handover session
sourceNote: The code stays private: you get a working shop set up for you, not a download of the source code.
